headline: Germany's DAX Falls Below 25,000 Amid Weak Economic Growth Data
summary: Germany's DAX index fell below the 25,000 threshold at the market open, pressured by weak domestic economic growth figures and ongoing budget debates in the Bundestag.
why: The DAX is Germany's premier benchmark stock index, aggregating the performance of the country's largest listed industrial and financial corporations.

impacts.name: DAX Index
impacts.why: Subdued macroeconomic growth figures weigh directly on German equity valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Weak domestic GDP growth figures and political uncertainty surrounding the federal budget pushed the DAX index below the 25,000 mark.
